# Through cut from the side of a box

Run `oracle.py` on the CadQuery 2.3.0 oracle. The `through-side` row in
`tests/fixtures/profiles/constructed.json` is generated by
`tools/cq_profile_probe.py` from this exact program.

A radius-1 cylinder through a 10 × 8 × 4 box along X removes 10π
at (0, 1, −½), from stock of volume 320 and area 304 about the origin.
The bore subtracts 2π from the two end faces and adds 20π of wall.
The result has one solid, six planar faces and one cylinder. The outer
bounds are unchanged. `expected.json` gives the closed form.

The oracle reports `ok` with volume lower by about 4.19e-7 and area
higher by about 1.26e-6. The box also extends an extra 2e-7 on its −X
side in the tight bounds. Volume and area are outside ADR-0005's
tolerance. The same rounded measurements appeared in all 72 runs,
24 each with one, two and four zygotes. A diagnostic run replacing
the through cut with a blind cut of depth −12 gave volume
288.58407346410206 and area 360.54866776461625, both within ADR-0005.
`tests/test_profile_probe.py::test_side_cut_matches_the_closed_form`
holds the recorded through cut to the desired closed form as a strict
`xfail`.
